title: Concept: File access built from input (php) — review required
description: In php, include $_GET['p']; assembles a filesystem path from parts. Traversal payloads (..%2f, absolute paths, symlink races) redirect the operation outside its directory. The php-specific remedy is confinement via an allowlist of includable files.
applicability: php codebases opening files with assembled paths; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file read or write when untrusted input reaches the path; HIGH severity because traversal payloads are trivial and impact is filesystem-wide.
